reviews.title: BEST CHAIR EVER
reviews.body: *Light weight. *Easy to carry - padded straps to wear like a backback *Easy open and close *Back "pocket" holds a lot of stuff and has a drawstring closure so nothing falls out * LARGE cup holder easily holds over-sized cups *VERY sturdy canopy - holds up extremely well, even in steady and gusty beach winds *Comfortable seat - no bar under the legs *Firm, sturdy, comfy arm rests and the back adjusts easily.We experience some pretty significant winds on our recent trip to the beach. The canopy handled it with ease. I was amazed! That being said............ if the canopy is up on a really windy day, somebody needs to be sitting in it or it will blow away. I tried to move the chair when the wind was blowing really hard and it almost knock me (a 160 lb woman) over. It pushed me backwards for several feet before i could stop it. I had to fall forward in the chair just to make it stop. It was actually hilarious. I wish I had a video of that to share........trying to come up with a negative, but there just are none. Best beach chair hands down.I write a fair amount of reviews and I try to be as fair and informative as I can. I've never been paid or offered discounts for any of them. Somebody sign me up for that!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 5, 2022

reviews.title: Amazing but with defect
reviews.body: The canopy hinge on one side is defective and locks. Only way to get it open was using a metal bottle opener. Not sure that will always work. Otherwise the chair is amazing. Great material and well built. Just very disappointing for such an expensive product to have a defect. And if your can't close the canopy, pushing the chair is a lot harder since having three canopy open takes up a lot more space.

reviews.title: Almost perfect!
reviews.body: Why did you pick this product vs others?:Bought 2 of these chairs a couple seasons ago. I wish I had at least 2 more. They are the best beach chairs!!! They are very comfortable (not so low that us older people can’t get in & out of them with ease), have their own little shade which is big enough to at least cover your head & face, a cup holder, a pocket on side & a big one on the back, they clip to secure closure after folded, & they store flat for easy packing in car. The sewn-in backpack straps make them a hands-free carry to the beach, leaving your hands free for other things & easy/light enough as a backpack so a pre-teen girl can easily carry her own plus other things in hands. The only negative I found was that you have to grab the bottom of the chair (the metal bars) in order to fold flat & you have to lay them down in the sand to do that. This sometimes flings sand on everything & is a little clunky/tough to figure out at first, but as long as you’re aware & careful, it’s not a huge deal. Even after 2 years, 4 beach trips, 2 winters in the garage, & many car rides strapped to the roof rack, they still fold relatively easily. The positives far outweigh the negatives!!! I’d highly recommend.

features: SUN. SURF. SAVOR. Relax oceanside in the adult SunShade Backpack Beach Chair from GCI Outdoor. Have it all with this 4-position reclining chair — stash essentials in the large back pocket and catch some rays or enjoy the shade with an adjustable canopy.

MADE IN THE SHADE. Recline in your own shady spot or soak in the sun rays - it's up to you thanks to the adjustable UPF 50 canopy and a 4-position reclining backrest. Note: SunShade can't be removed, but can be pushed completely back.

A FRONT ROW SEAT. Perfect for waterside activities or backyard lawn barbecues, the SunShade is ready for anything. With a built-in beverage holder, solid armrests and great back support, you can enjoy more time outside with family and friends.

PORTABLE COMFORT. Relax easier thanks to a mesh backrest for continuous airflow and a cushioned head pillow for extra support. Store your towel, sunscreen and snacks in the oversized pouch, while the adjustable backpack straps keep your hands free.
TECH SPECS. 250 lbs Weight Capacity; Open: 26" Depth x 24.2" Width x 30.9" Height (Seat Height: 11") [Excludes SunShade]; Folded: 4.3" Depth x 24.2" Width x 28.1" Height; Chair Weight: 10.2 lbs.
